name: FutureHouse
tagline: AI agents that automate scientific literature research and discovery.
description: FutureHouse is a nonprofit AI-for-science lab building AI agents that automate steps of the research process. Its free FutureHouse Platform exposes specialized agents — including Crow, Falcon, Owl, and Phoenix — for literature search, synthesis, and chemistry, plus Kosmos, an 'AI Scientist' that runs autonomous multi-step analyses. The agents are available through a web app and an open API.
insight: Nonprofit funded mainly by Eric & Wendy Schmidt; its founders spun the Kosmos AI Scientist into for-profit Edison Scientific in Nov 2025.
edge: Unlike chat-based research tools, its agents are tuned and benchmarked on scientific literature tasks — PaperQA2 posted superhuman lit-search scores.

references.title: FutureHouse debuts AI scientist Kosmos and for-profit spinoff
